A target market is the intended group of users. Knowing the user helps the designer make relevant choices.
Nightwear needs include comfort, movement, fit, climate and care. The item must perform during rest and routine use.
Personal style is considered alongside function. A useful design can also express the user's preferred colours and details.

The pattern envelope identifies views, sizes, fabrics and notions. It gives the information needed before selecting and cutting materials.
A grainline guides how a pattern piece aligns with the fabric grain. Correct alignment supports expected hang and performance.
Notches help match corresponding construction points. They support accurate alignment during assembly.
